title: ElevenLabs Music
description: Generate high quality, realistic music with fine controls using Elevenlabs Music!

pricing.text: Your request will cost $0.6 per output audio minute. The audio will be rounded up to the closest minute. For instance, a generation with 30 seconds output will be billed as 1 minute.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The text prompt describing the music to generate Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: composition_plan
inputs.tooltip: The composition plan for the music JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: music_length_ms
inputs.tooltip: The length of the song to generate in milliseconds. Used only in conjunction with prompt. Must be between 3000ms and 600000ms. Optional - if not provided, the model will choose a length based on the prompt. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: force_instrumental
inputs.tooltip: If true, guarantees that the generated song will be instrumental. If false, the song may or may not be instrumental depending on the prompt. Can only be used with prompt.

inputs.name: respect_sections_durations
inputs.tooltip: Controls how strictly section durations in the composition_plan are enforced. It will only have an effect if it is used with composition_plan. When set to true, the model will precisely respect each section's duration_ms from the plan. When set to false, the model may adjust individual section durations which will generally lead to better generation quality and improved latency, while always preserving the total song

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: Output format of the generated audio. Formatted as codec_sample_rate_bitrate. So an mp3 with 22.05kHz sample rate at 32kbs is represented as mp3_22050_32. MP3 with 192kbps bitrate requires you to be subscribed to Creator tier or above. PCM with 44.1kHz sample rate requires you to be subscribed to Pro tier or above.
